name: drawer
useFor: Use on phones for a choice or short task that comes from the bottom of the screen (choose a basemap). People can drag or flick it away. The body fades at an edge (fade-xy) where more content scrolls past it, either way.
constraints: A drawer that cannot be dismissed by dragging
source: Not in Figma. Drawn in Mireye's grammar: the sheet
title: Drawer
description: A square Bone panel pulled from an edge with a 1px Stone line on its inner edge, a square Stone handle, and a drag that follows the finger; it slides on the drawer curve.
